issues.location: negation of A subset A union B in the second proof
issues.finding: The example has three membership predicates without their x operand, and its explanatory counterexample to A subset A union B is printed as not-in C instead of not-in A union B. The next paragraph correctly gives x not-in A union B.
issues.proposed_resolution: Supply x in the introductory not-in predicate and both unpacked positive clauses; use x not-in A union B for the counterexample.

issues.location: negation of A subset C in the transitivity proof
issues.finding: The explanatory equivalence omits x on the left of both in C and not-in C, although the same witness x is quantified on the same line.
issues.proposed_resolution: Write x in C and x not-in C for the two predicates.

issues.location: first case of the equality-from-union-and-intersection proof
issues.finding: The explanatory quote says x belongs to A but prints bare not-in B for the second half of the same witness condition.
issues.proposed_resolution: Write x not-in B in the first case.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target supplies the witness x and restores the correct set A union B in the negated-subset example. Bounded comparison repairs record these changes without modifying the frozen English source.
